description: Implementation of QuicServerSessionBase class handling QUIC server session logic, including configuration negotiation, bandwidth estimation, stream creation, and connection management.

classes.name: QuicServerSessionBase
classes.description: Handles QUIC server session management, including configuration, bandwidth estimation, stream creation, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the crypto stream and performs session setup.

methods.name: OnConfigNegotiated
methods.description: Handles post-configuration negotiation logic, including setting initial RTT and bandwidth resumption parameters.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the connection is closed, including canceling outstanding callbacks.

methods.name: OnBandwidthUpdateTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout for bandwidth update, potentially sending address tokens.

methods.name: OnCongestionWindowChange
methods.description: Handles congestion window changes, potentially sending bandwidth estimates to the client.

methods.name: ShouldCreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Determines if an incoming stream should be created based on stream ID and connection state.

methods.name: ShouldCreateOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if an outgoing bidirectional stream can be created.

methods.name: ShouldCreateOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if an outgoing unidirectional stream can be created.

methods.name: GetMutableCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the crypto stream.

methods.name: GetCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the crypto stream.

methods.name: BandwidthToCachedParameterBytesPerSecond
methods.description: Converts bandwidth to a cached parameter value in bytes per second.

methods.name: SendSettingsToCryptoStream
methods.description: Serializes and sends session settings to the crypto stream for resumption.

methods.name: GetSSLConfig
methods.description: Returns SSL configuration, including signature algorithms and ticket support.

methods.name: GenerateCachedNetworkParameters
methods.description: Generates cached network parameters including RTT, bandwidth, and serving region.
